title: Remote-bound console exposes live state and mutation token over GET
description: dashboard --host can bind off-loopback. GET /api/state and rendered pages do not run the POST Host/Origin/token validator, render full live state, and inject the consoleToken into POST forms. A network peer on a remote bind can read state and recover the mutation token.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-loopback console binds require an explicit unsafe/auth mode, or are refused by default.
Host validation applies to all console routes, including GET HTML and /api/state.
Mutation tokens are not served to unauthenticated GET clients, with server tests covering remote-bound access.
